hits.title: Centific Announces Leadership Transition: Chuen Hong Lew to Succeed Venkat Rangapuram as Chief Executive Officer | Centific
hits.snippet: #### Former Granite Asia Partner to Lead Centific's Next Phase of Growth as a Global Data and AI Solutions Provider. Centific, a leading global data and AI solutions company, today announced that Chuen Hong Lew will become Chief Executive Officer, effective August 3, 2026, succeeding Venkat Rangapuram, who has led the company through a period of significant growth and global expansion. Chuen Hong joins Centific from Granite Asia, where he served as a Partner, leading the firm's partnerships ecosystem and special strategic projects. This gave him broad visibility into the AI ecosystem and the dynamics shaping the sector. “Chuen Hong is well positioned to lead Centific as we accelerate our ambition to become a leading global data and AI solutions company,” said Tiak Koon Loh, Chairman of the Board of Centific. “The Board is grateful to Venkat and the management team for the strong foundation they have built and is confident that Chuen Hong will carry this momentum into Centific’s next phase of growth.” Chuen Hong previously served as Chief Executive of Singapore's Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA), shaping digital technology strategy and AI adoption at a national level. hits.title: Pactera EDGE announces strategic rebrand as Centific | MultiLingual
hits.snippet: REDMOND, Wash. /PRNewswire/ — Pactera EDGE, a world-class digital solutions provider for the data-driven, intelligent enterprise, announced today that it has rebranded as Centific. The rebranding, which includes a new name, logo, and visual identity system, takes effect immediately. The rebranding as Centific comes three years after Pactera EDGE spun off from its parent company, Pactera Technology International Ltd., back in 2020.
